en: A vintage Spanish postal card with a red 10-centimos España stamp on the upper left, cancelled with a black postmark. The printed heading reads 'TARJETA POSTAL'. The right half is filled with elegant handwritten cursive in Spanish, addressing a recipient and mentioning Santander and Sardinero. The card is aged, with yellowed paper and some stains, and there is no photograph or illustration on this side.
